about: Where the film is played and downloaded from. One file decides it for both sites: this site and the creator's personal site (which reads the published copy, hosts.json). Switch with: npm run host -- tencent | cloudflare. The other host is used only when the active one cannot be reached at all (an error, or nothing at all within 10 s of Play), never because it is slow. Manual: personal site repository, docs/film-hosting.md.

tencent.name: 腾讯云上海（轻量对象存储）

file.about: The creator's own 4K web export, never re-encoded, re-muxed or compressed by an agent (2026-10-23). Both hosts hold this exact file; the ETag both return is its MD5.
